revenue.source: FY2025/FY2024: Iberdrola Consolidated Annual Accounts 2025 income statement (Revenue 44,076 / 42,988, restated 2024). FY2023: Yahoo Finance IBDRY financials (49,335, as originally reported; may not be on the restated basis, so FY2023 is not strictly comparable).

operating_income.source: FY2025/FY2024: Consolidated Annual Accounts 2025 'Operating profit - EBIT' 9,755 / 7,639 (2024 restated; originally reported 9,729). FY2023: Iberdrola 2024 Results report, EBIT 8,973.1.

d_and_a.source: Derived as company EBITDA minus EBIT from Annual Accounts 2025: 15,956-9,755=6,201 (FY2025); 14,642-7,639=7,003 (FY2024). This includes provisions and valuation adjustments, not only pure D&A. FY2023 not found (search limit reached).

capex.source: FY2025: total gross investment of EUR 14,460M per Iberdrola FY2025 results presentation (25 Feb 2026). This is a gross investment figure, not cash capex. FY2023 and FY2024 not found (search limit reached).

revenue_growth.source: Assumption. FY2025 revenue grew about 2.5% (44,076 vs 42,988). Growth is driven by regulated-network rate-base growth (RAB up 12%), partly offset by lower power prices. Growth is modest, fading to 2.5%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption. FY2025 EBIT margin was 9,755/44,076 = 22.1%. Held flat because network growth is offset by power-price pressure.

tax_rate.source: Assumption. Spanish statutory corporate tax rate of 25%. Group effective rate not verified.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption. FY2025 gross investment was 14,460/44,076 = 32.8%. I haircut this to 25% to blend in some normalisation and to exclude acquisitions and partner-funded spend. This is a key judgement: capex above D&A leaves very low FCF, so the reviewer should revisit it.

wacc.source: Assumption. Regulated-utility WACC: about 3.2% Spanish 10-year yield plus a beta of about 0.7 times a 5.5% ERP, with BBB+ credit and leverage of about 40% debt. Not computed from market data.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption. Long-run euro-area inflation of about 2%.

net_debt.source: Iberdrola FY2025 results presentation: net debt of EUR 50.2bn at Dec 2025, down EUR 1.5bn. This is the company's headline figure and may differ slightly from total debt (excluding leases) minus cash and short-term investments. The rounded figure should be checked against the balance sheet.

diluted_shares.source: Yahoo Finance IBDRY financials, diluted average shares 1,686,847.84 thousand, converted to millions (weighted average diluted, FY2025). Not checked against the filing.
